(j) Liens arising under zoning/building/environmental laws or governmental control rights, including condemnation/eminent domain

(n) Liens securing Indebtedness permitted under Section 6.01(m), limited to acquired asset and proceeds

(o) Liens securing Indebtedness permitted under Section 6.01(n) on acquired assets/Capital Stock of newly acquired Restricted Subsidiary, subject to no-extension and not-created-in-contemplation conditions
(p) Liens consisting of contractual setoff/netting rights, deposit account liens, bankers liens, and similar banking-related liens
(q) Liens on assets/Capital Stock of Restricted Subsidiaries that are not Loan Parties securing their permitted Indebtedness
(r) Liens securing non-debt obligations under operating, reciprocal easement or similar agreements
(s) Liens securing Indebtedness incurred under Sections 6.01(w) and/or (z), subject to Intercreditor Agreement unless not required for 6.01(w) debt
(t) [reserved]
(u) Liens securing Indebtedness/obligations up to greater of $30,000,000 and 50% of Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA, subject to Intercreditor Agreement if on Collateral
(v) Liens securing judgments/awards/attachments not constituting an Event of Default, and litigation settlement pledges
(w) Leases, licenses, subleases/sublicenses not securing Indebtedness, and ground leases
(x) Liens on securities subject to repurchase agreements constituting permitted Investments
(y) Liens securing LC/bond/guaranty obligations permitted under Sections 6.01(d),(e),(g),(aa),(cc)
(z) Liens arising from conditional sale/title retention/consignment arrangements or by operation of UCC Article 2
(aa) Intercompany Liens in favor of Loan Parties or non-Loan Party Restricted Subsidiaries securing permitted intercompany debt
(bb) Liens on insurance policies/proceeds securing premium financing
(cc) Liens on inventory/proceeds from customer progress payments or securing documentary LC/bankers acceptance obligations
(dd) Liens securing obligations of the type described in Section 6.01(f) and/or 6.01(s)
(ee) Liens on Capital Stock of joint ventures/Unrestricted Subsidiaries and customary JV rights
(ff) Liens on cash/Cash Equivalents arising from defeasance/discharge/redemption of Indebtedness
(gg) Liens consisting of prior rights of consignees/lenders under consignment arrangements
(hh) Liens securing obligations under Section 6.01(hh), subject to Intercreditor Agreement at issuing bank's request
(ii) Ground leases in respect of real property on which facilities are located
(jj) Liens consisting of Crown grant reservations or statutory rights under Canadian law
(kk) Liens not securing Indebtedness for borrowed money that are customary to the business
(ll) Liens on inventory/goods proceeds securing documentary LC/bankers acceptance obligations
(mm) [reserved]
(nn) Liens arising in connection with escrow arrangements established in connection with the Transactions
